cli: Hard-disabled without filesystem driver; emits DISABLED_PENDING_SCOPE_AND_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, exit 2. Requiring the module never opens files.

positive_binding.future_gate: Finite explicit call IDs positively bound by command metadata to receipt-only creation/read operations. Package --candidate-root references, timestamps, adjacency, schema markers and names alone are not positive binding. Do not invent IDs. API requires an explicit finite allowlist and rejects unbound output before text unescape.

selection: Buffer-only literal ASCII schema-marker and fixed root-date prefilter, then response_item/direct payload custom_tool_call_output or function_call_output and exact allowed call_id. Optional tool name must be exec/exec_command normalized enum. No JSON.parse of envelope/output; unknown metadata and bodies are structurally skipped without UTF-8 interpretation.
supported_wrappers: Only a raw quoted output string or an output array with exactly one entry having exactly type=text and text=quoted-string. Arrays with zero or multiple entries, including receipt plus ordinary quality text, are rejected before any unescape. Exactly one schema-bearing text part and exactly one literal schema marker within that part are required. The selected part must be exactly one receipt JSON object with literal opening/closing object boundaries and optional trailing whitespace; mixed stdout prefixes/suffixes, objects/other entry kinds and unfamiliar wrappers are unsupported and counted, not adaptively decoded.
lexical_processing: Unescape only selected schema-bearing text literal to Buffer, with 64KiB cap and ASCII-only decoded bytes. This supports Python builder ensure_ascii=True output, including retained nested Unicode JSON escapes, but rejects raw/non-ASCII first-layer values. Lexically validate exact builder receipt schema and grammar, duplicate keys, trailing bytes, key and node/depth limits without JSON.parse or semantic result-value conversion. No ordinary quality/model/row values are interpreted.

exact_receipt_schema.nested_schema: Exact current builder counts/sha256/gates/boundaries key sets and JSON value kinds; roster string-array and status string. Values remain byte slices, not analytical evidence.

reconstruction: Sort raw unescaped ASCII key tokens and lexically format object/array indentation two spaces, separators matching Python json.dump(sort_keys=True,indent=2), ending with one newline. Preserve primitive JSON lexemes without interpreting their values. Reconstructed entire original-byte candidate must match the known receipt SHA before any hash field is accepted/exported.
mismatch_behavior: Counters only; no rejected candidate values or hashes exported.
release_gate: Projection/status authentication requires exactly one complete SHA-matching candidate across the entire bounded input, no input-bound hit and zero oversized-line skips. Matching duplicate copies are ambiguous: retain counts only and emit AMBIGUOUS_MATCHING_COPIES_NO_RELEASE with null projection. Any input-byte cap hit or oversized-line skip marks the scan incomplete and emits INCOMPLETE_INPUT_NO_RELEASE with null projection even when an earlier complete candidate matched. No partial-scan authentication release.
synthetic_api: Expected hash and explicit call IDs are injected only for synthetic fixtures. Resource overrides may tighten but never raise fixed maxima. No actual history scan/receipt recovery authorized by tests.
